detail: Initial tool reads of instructions/pins were not limited to8192 bytes. No guest or runtime group executed; all subsequent capture reads bounded.
Pinned evidence/source revisions absent in root object store; task alternates flattened dependency-first from immutable closeout donor and root. No fetch or donor/root mutation.
Source ls-tree against root lacked pinned object; corrected same-task reads to isolated task alternate object store. No guest consumed.

Initial checkpoint publisher used Python append mode for messageboard, preserving existing bytes. Final publisher uses prescribed echo append and immediate tail verification. No rewrite/truncation occurred.
